public_rationale: This forecast applies only if things kept getting worse for OpenAI. He gave no measure for that, and the available evidence does not show it. For context, the next primary round was not harder by the usual measures. It was announced as $110B at a $730B pre-money valuation in February 2026 and reportedly closed at $122B and $852B post-money, against $40B at $300B in March 2025. Part of Amazon's money is staged on conditions. Because the antecedent is not shown, the forecast cannot be scored.
limitations: 'Deteriorate' is undefined, so a reader could argue it was or was not met.
